filters.name: NewBlue Earthquake
filters.description: Animated shake, rotation, zoom, and occasional motion blur.

filters.name: NewBlue Wiggle
filters.description: Animated sine warp with stretch, replicate, and transparent edge modes.

filters.name: NewBlue Wiggle Fun House
filters.description: The Fun House preset with adjustable sine warp and edges.

filters.name: Vegas 2D Shadow
filters.description: A soft black shadow behind transparent areas of the layer.

filters.name: Vegas Border
filters.description: An inset border with adjustable color and optional bevel shading.

filters.name: Vegas Channel Blend
filters.description: Mixes RGB channels with optional row normalization.

filters.name: Vegas Color Corrector
filters.description: Adjusts low, mid, and high chroma wheels and saturation.

filters.name: Vegas Color Corrector Secondary
filters.description: Selects a hue range for hue, saturation, and luminance correction.

filters.name: Vegas Color Curves
filters.description: Adjusts fixed shadow, midtone, and highlight curve points.

filters.name: Vegas Convolution Kernel
filters.description: A cross-shaped convolution kernel with scale and offset controls.

filters.name: Vegas Deform
filters.description: Scales each side of the image and applies horizontal and vertical shear.

filters.name: Vegas Glow
filters.description: Spreads bright areas into a tinted glow.

filters.name: Vegas Height Map
filters.description: Uses the layer as both the height source and displaced image.

filters.name: Vegas HSL Adjust
filters.description: Adjusts hue, saturation, and luminance.

filters.name: Vegas LAB Adjust
filters.description: Adjusts Lab lightness and chroma, with luminance inversion and desaturation.

filters.name: Vegas Light Rays
filters.description: Draws rays from bright pixels toward a movable light source.

filters.name: Vegas Mirror
filters.description: Reflects one side across a movable axis with a background color.

filters.name: Vegas Pinch Punch
filters.description: Pinches or expands an elliptical region around a movable center.

filters.name: Vegas Radial Blur
filters.description: Blurs along radial lines with a movable center and constant-length option.

filters.name: Vegas Spherize
filters.description: A cosine radial warp that bulges or contracts a centered region.

filters.name: Vegas Starburst
filters.description: Adds sampled rays around bright areas. Raise Star Intensity to see the rays.

filters.name: Vegas Swirl
filters.description: Twists an elliptical region around a movable center.

filters.name: Vegas Unsharp Mask
filters.description: Sharpens or softens detail. Raise Amount and Radius to apply the effect.

filters.name: Vegas Wave
filters.description: A horizontal and vertical sine displacement with adjustable phases.
